Start at https://www.google.com and complete the following task.

I’m trying to book a perfume bar or custom scent experience for a future wedding, and I don’t want just one random lead—I want a real shortlist I could confidently contact for a destination event anywhere in the world. Please use public web pages to find 8 to 10 perfume-bar, fragrance-bar, or scent-activation vendors that appear to do weddings, private events, or luxury event activations, and for each one verify whether they explicitly mention international travel, destination events, global service, or leave that as not shown if you can’t confirm it. Compare them on the details that would actually matter to me: whether they look wedding-appropriate, what kind of guest experience they offer, whether they seem able to handle on-site personalization, what regions they mention serving, how polished the setup looks from photos, and exactly how I would inquire or book them. Keep the strongest 4 vendor pages open, including at least 2 that clearly suggest international or destination capability and at least 1 that looks especially strong for weddings. Then give me a final ranked shortlist of the best 5 options, explain which single vendor you’d contact first for a destination wedding and why, and include the booking or contact method for each finalist.

Rules:
- You may use search engines and open new tabs. When the task asks you to leave a page open, keep it open in its own tab and say in your final answer which page is in which tab.
- Do NOT use cached/archived copies of pages (e.g. web.archive.org); work from the live sites.
- If a site you need is blocked (bot check, login wall, error), first try to get through it — complete a bot check yourself, retry, or use another route to the same page. If it still cannot be reached, say so explicitly in your answer and do not fill in from memory what you could not read on the page.
- When the task is complete, give your final answer as plain text in your last message.

   *Title*: *Wedding Perfume Bars - Luxury Perfume Bar & Lip Lab - Glitters and Grace*

---

## Comprehensive Review of 10 Fragrance & Perfume Bar Vendors

### 1. Bios Apothecary (Bios Weddings)
* **Live URL**: `https://www.biosapothecary.com/pages/weddings`
* **International / Destination Verification**: **Explicitly Confirmed**. Their official FAQ explicitly states: *"Yes. Bios produces destination celebrations internationally. Whether you are planning an intimate private gathering or a large-scale wedding activation, our team can coordinate travel logistics and custom production based on your event location."*
* **Wedding Appropriateness**: **Exceptional**. Has an entire dedicated division (*Bios Weddings*) with "Love Notes" bride/groom bespoke scent consultations, natural botanical perfumery, companion formulas archived for anniversaries, and curated wedding-party gifting.
* **Guest Experience**: Guests step up to an interactive botanical fragrance atelier, discovering pure botanical essences, resinous woods, and rare absolutes guided by perfumers to formulate their custom blend.
* **On-Site Personalization**: High. Custom bespoke labels, branded bottles, curated scent menus matching wedding colors, plus preserved botanicals, florals, crystals, and gemstones placed directly in or on the keepsake bottles.
* **Regions Mentioned**: Flagship showrooms in New York City and Siesta Key coastal retreat; produces destination celebrations across the US and internationally worldwide.
* **Visual Setup & Polish**: Editorial, minimalist apothecary chic with amber and clear flacons, natural stone pedestals, clean organic styling, and botanical accents.
* **How to Inquire / Book**: Online inquiry form at `biosapothecary.com/pages/weddings` ("Plan your Celebration") requesting event date, guest count, vision, and contact details, or via their contact page (`biosapothecary.com/pages/contact`).

---

### 2. Luminé Bar (by She Is Candles, LLC)
* **Live URL**: `https://theluminebar.com/`
* **International / Destination Verification**: **Explicitly Confirmed**. Website header and body state: *"bringing bespoke perfume, cologne, room spray and candle making to your wedding, brand activation, or corporate event anywhere in the world"* and *"Available nationwide and internationally — we travel to you."*
* **Wedding Appropriateness**: **Very High**. Features specific bridal and wedding packages, bridal shower blending suites, a custom bride wedding-day scent session, and wedding reception guest favor activations.
* **Guest Experience**: Turnkey multi-sensory bar where guests explore a library of 100+ fine fragrance accords, blending their personal perfume, cologne, linen room spray, or poured wax candle with host guidance.
* **On-Site Personalization**: Guests compound their formulation on-site; bottles and candles receive personalized event labels and packaged presentation boxes.
* **Regions Mentioned**: Based in Birmingham, Alabama; explicitly serves nationwide (US) and internationally worldwide.
* **Visual Setup & Polish**: Sleek modern luxury with black-and-gold branded bar displays, warm ambient lighting, coordinated glassware, and styled linen/rental table settings.
* **How to Inquire / Book**: Direct inquiry form on `theluminebar.com/#inquire` ("Tell Us About Your Event") or direct booking buttons for consultations; pricing starts at $850 for 20 guests and scales up.

---

### 3. The Perfume & Cologne Bar
* **Live URL**: `https://perfumeevent.com/pages/perfume-cologne-bar`
* **International / Destination Verification**: **Explicitly Confirmed**. States: *"With a network of expert stylists across North America, we've delivered our unique experience to events worldwide and are a fully mobile activation, ready to bring our magic to any location! Whether your celebration is set on a sun-kissed beach, at a mountain ski resort, or anywhere in between, we can be there!"*
* **Wedding Appropriateness**: **High**. Works frequently with destination management companies (DMCs), luxury weddings, bridal showers, and high-profile galas.
* **Guest Experience**: High-throughput interactive bar (up to 40 custom scents per hour per station, accommodating 30 to 1,000+ guests). Stylists guide guests through proprietary accord pairings.
* **On-Site Personalization**: 20ml or 60ml bottles filled on demand with custom-printed cap choices, bespoke graphic labels/artwork, mirror signage decals, and optional guest names on bottles.
* **Regions Mentioned**: Stylist network across North America (US/Canada) with international delivery worldwide.
* **Visual Setup & Polish**: Clean, crisp white display bars, mirrored trays, polished metal bottle atomizers, and customized branded vinyl signage decals.
* **How to Inquire / Book**: Web form at `perfumeevent.com/pages/contact` with response promised within 24 hours. A 50% non-refundable deposit confirms the event date.

---

### 4. Gavin Luxe (The Haus Bar)
* **Live URL**: `https://gavinluxe.com/pages/the-haus-bar-by-gavin-luxe-mobile-perfume-experience-custom-fragrance-bar`
* **International / Destination Verification**: **Explicitly Confirmed for Destination Events**. Website states: *"BASED IN SOCAL. BOOKING EVERYWHERE. Destination weddings and out-of-state brand events welcome."* Their travel FAQ confirms: *"Travel beyond SoCal is available, we quote it on top of your package."*
* **Wedding Appropriateness**: **High**. Strong emphasis on wedding cocktail hours and receptions, providing an elevated alternative to photo booths or traditional favors.
* **Guest Experience**: 3 service tiers (Essential, Signature, Reserve). Guests explore 6 to 12 signature luxury fragrance accords, mix bespoke notes, and take home 10ml or full 30ml bottles.
* **On-Site Personalization**: Custom event foil labels, personalized bottle packaging, luxury gift bags, tissue presentation, and customized fragrance naming menus.
* **Regions Mentioned**: Home base in Southern California (Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego), traveling nationwide and to destination weddings globally on custom quote.
* **Visual Setup & Polish**: Modern editorial, monochromatic black, white, and acrylic staging with glass dropper decanters and custom menu cards.
* **How to Inquire / Book**: Event inquiry form on `gavinluxe.com/pages/the-haus-bar...` specifying package choice ($3,500+ Essential, $6,000+ Signature, or custom Reserve) with 1-business-day response time.

---

### 5. Glitters and Grace
* **Live URL**: `https://glittersandgrace.com/wedding-perfume-bars/`
* **International / Destination Verification**: **Not Shown**. Site explicitly lists regional coverage: *"Serving Chicagoland, Indianapolis, Milwaukee."* Travel beyond the US Midwest is not confirmed.
* **Wedding Appropriateness**: **Exceptional**. Specifically architected around wedding receptions, timeline flow (cocktail hour vs. dinner dancing), and venue aesthetics.
* **Guest Experience**: Deep perfumery exploration featuring 120+ notes and 12 base accords. Guests spend 5–10 minutes creating nuanced botanical and gourmand fragrances.
* **On-Site Personalization**: Custom bottle shapes, personalized wedding labels, custom guest names, and formulas logged for reorders.
* **Regions Mentioned**: Illinois (Chicago), Indiana (Indianapolis), and Wisconsin (Milwaukee).
* **Visual Setup & Polish**: Highly styled setups with 3 distinct footprints: 8-Foot Artisan Table, 7-Foot Luxury Counter, or French-style Wedding Cart, dressed with matching linens, floral arrangements, and gold risers.
* **How to Inquire / Book**: Inquiry form at `glittersandgrace.com/book-with-us/`, phone at `815.296.1657`, or email at `perfume@glittersandgrace.com`.

---

### 6. CD Noir
* **Live URL**: `https://cdnoir.co.uk/pages/events-souvenirs`
* **International / Destination Verification**: **Not Shown** (UK nationwide only). FAQ states: *"Do you travel outside London? Yes. Travel fees may apply depending on location."* No explicit international destination service confirmed.
* **Wedding Appropriateness**: **High**. Curated as a serene sensory respite during lavish wedding receptions and upscale British celebrations.
* **Guest Experience**: Scent discovery focusing on calm, guided selection across three bar designs (The Signature Tower, The Crystal Luxe Bar, and The Modern Trio Bar). Guests receive a finished 30ml or 50ml perfume.
* **On-Site Personalization**: Personalized gold-embossed labels, bespoke scent cards, and custom-branded gift bags.
* **Regions Mentioned**: London and wider United Kingdom.
* **Visual Setup & Polish**: Ornate crystal decanters, gold architectural display towers, and understated velvet accents.
* **How to Inquire / Book**: Online quote submission at `cdnoir.co.uk/pages/perfume-bar-general-request`. Pricing starts from £1,450.

---

### 7. Place of Aroma
* **Live URL**: `https://www.placeofaroma.com/perfume-bar-for-events`
* **International / Destination Verification**: **Not Shown**. Page states: *"Travel Options Available: Anywhere in the United States. For locations other than listed, please email us..."* International destination travel is not explicitly offered.
* **Wedding Appropriateness**: **Moderate to High**. Geared towards high-traffic events, galas, brand activations, and large wedding receptions.
* **Guest Experience**: Streamlined step-by-step blending (Discover, Choose, Mix, Create) with capacity for 50 to 500+ guests, guided by 2+ fragrance hosts.
* **On-Site Personalization**: 10ml or 15ml spray bottles with co-branded custom labels and custom scent naming.
* **Regions Mentioned**: Nationwide across the United States.
* **Visual Setup & Polish**: 6-to-8ft illuminated or wood-paneled bar setup, organized amber glass dropper bottles, and clean signage.
* **How to Inquire / Book**: Form on page or email `help@placeofaroma.com` / `admin@placeofaroma.com`. 50% non-refundable deposit required at booking, balance due 7 days prior.

---

### 8. Theory Perfume
* **Live URL**: `https://www.theoryperfume.com/`
* **International / Destination Verification**: **Not Shown**. Site and FAQ confirm: *"based in Scottsdale, Arizona serving weddings... nationwide."* International travel is not stated.
* **Wedding Appropriateness**: **High**. Tailored for desert destination weddings, bachelorette weekends, and private resort celebrations.
* **Guest Experience**: 4-step guided process (Explore Notes, Blend, Bottle, Take Home). Clean, phthalate-free, IFRA-compliant accords inspired by fine designer fragrances.

* **Regions Mentioned**: Scottsdale/Phoenix, Arizona, and US nationwide travel.

* **How to Inquire / Book**: "Start Here" contact form on homepage with name, date, guest count, and service preferences.

---

### 9. House of AB
* **Live URL**: `https://www.houseofab.uk/`
* **International / Destination Verification**: **Not Shown**. Site explicitly mentions services *"across the UK"* with no confirmation of international destinations.
* **Wedding Appropriateness**: **High**. Specializes in multicultural luxury weddings, Nikkahs, engagement parties, and evening receptions.
* **Guest Experience**: Unique Middle Eastern and Western fusion offering three distinct stations: Fragrance Stall (8 bespoke perfumes), Attar Stall (pure Arabian concentrated perfume oils), and Scented Hand Cream Cart.

* **Regions Mentioned**: United Kingdom nationwide.
* **Visual Setup & Polish**: Custom vintage-style carts and wooden stalls with ornate Middle Eastern attar decanters, gold trays, and floral garland trims.
* **How to Inquire / Book**: Dedicated booking engine at `quote.houseofab.uk`, inquiry form on site, or email `officialhouseofab@gmail.com`. Non-refundable deposit required.

---

* **International / Destination Verification**: **Not Shown**. Explicitly regional: *"Based in Northern California. Service Area: San Francisco Bay Area, Sacramento Valley, North Bay, East Bay, South Bay, Northern Central Valley. Travel fees apply for events outside our region."*

"The Perfume Bar team was incredibly easy to work with and provided such a personalized and thoughtful experience for our event. We appreciated all of the attention to detail, the amazingly courteous team, and the interactive experience that gave every guest a unique opportunity and personalized take-away!" - 2025 BRIDE

Thousands of Bottles

We have mastered the art and science of scent and have shared our knowledge and guidance with thousands of guests at grand openings, corporate events, weddings, bridal showers, bat-mitzvahs. sweet sixteens, and more.

We believe in personalization and that each guest should leave not just with a gift, but an exceptional experience. We are constantly honing our craft and providing more innovative options for our clients.

Eau de You

Everyone has a fragrance or cologne at home, but most people have never created their own!

More importantly, guests get to create this unique item from the highest quality ingredients.

The Perfume & Cologne Bar started in luxury retail (sold at Sephora and Bloomingdales) and will always maintain the highest, finest, and purest raw ingredients.

Service With a Smile

Drop an inquiry on our website or ask a question at an event, our team is here to take care of you. All of our Stylists are well versed in the language and science of scent and more importantly in the language of service.

We guarantee every guest has an exceptional experience, personal attention, and expert advice.

From Sea to Shining Sea

We have Stylists and distribution centers across North America and have successfully delivered our unique experience all over the world.

We can be anywhere, from beaches to skiing and everything in between. We truly act as a partner, sharing our clients goals and successfully executing all of our events with minimal involvement to the planner.

Our team works seamlessly with event planners and event organizers near you to bring exceptional experiences.

Bios Weddings creates immersive fragrance experiences for weddings, bridal celebrations, bachelor and bachelorette weekends, destination retreats, and luxury guest gifting. Booking Policy

Last Updated: 13/02/2026

1. Securing Your Date

To secure your event date with House of AB:

A booking request must be submitted in writing.

A non-refundable deposit is required.

Your date is only confirmed once the deposit has been received.

Dates are not held without payment.

2. Payment Terms

The remaining balance must be paid prior to the event date (as stated on your invoice).

Failure to complete payment may result in cancellation of services.

If an event is cancelled within 30 days, House of AB reserves the right to require full payment of the agreed amount.

3. Event Details

At the time of booking, clients must provide:

Event date

Venue location

Selected service(s)

Quantity required

Any personalisation requests

All event details must be finalised in advance to ensure smooth delivery.

4. Changes to Booking

Any changes to the agreed service, quantities, or timing must be made in writing and may be subject to additional charges.

Changes requested close to the event date cannot be guaranteed.

5. Setup & Access

Clients must ensure:

Adequate space is provided for setup

Timely access to the venue

A safe working environment for staff

Delays in access may reduce service time.

6. Contact

For all booking enquiries or amendments:
